title: Irish Stir-Fry with Nutty Veggies
description: A hearty, one-pan Irish stir-fry dish loaded with nutty roasted vegetables and a hint of velvety creaminess.

ingredients.name: Nutty roasted vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, beets, or parsnips

instructions: Toss the chopped kale with 1 tbsp of olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast the kale in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until slightly caramelized.
In a large skillet, heat the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the stir-fry sauce and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the nutty roasted vegetables and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
Stir in the softened cream cheese until combined.
Add the cooked kale to the skillet and toss to combine.
Season with fry seasoning if desired.
